answers.rationale: The requirement specifies an HVAC unit for a switchgear assembly, which aligns with the description of the CROWN-EHOUSE product, as it includes pre-built electrical houses with integrated systems, including HVAC.
The detailed busbar and insulation requirements, along with the ANSI standards and short circuit rating, match the specifications of the CROWN-ARMV arc-resistant metal-clad MV switchgear.
The requirement for porcelain circuit breaker primary spouts is a specific feature of high-quality MV switchgear, which aligns with the CROWN-ARMV product.
The grounding requirements, including NEMA ground pads and a dedicated ground bus, are standard features of the CROWN-ARMV switchgear, which is designed for substation applications.
